verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents a dedicated API and data platform: a public OTLP ingestion endpoint, Metrics API v2, scores via API/SDK, and querying the API from Python or JS/TS SDKs. A long-term community user independently confirms an OpenAPI spec that is easy to implement in any language and that they drive the product selectively via the API. Missing for 10: no API reference content showing full endpoint coverage in the pack, no OpenAPI spec found at the standard probed paths, and a hands-on report that the trace retrieval API is 'brutally slow' for bulk reads.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Langfuse can receive traces on the `/api/public/otel` (OTLP) endpoint.
